fact: The World Bank appraisal says the Unified Social Registry (RSU), begun in 2018, is delayed, and the Safety Nets Project will fund its management information system, with a beneficiary operations system (BOMS) whose household data will be fed into the RSU and a digital payment platform for safety net programmes.
